title: Compile elevation and grade-separated road structures
acceptance: an authoritative and distributable NYC-compatible elevation/DEM source is selected, pinned, documented, and ingested by the compiler
road elevations/grades are generated in meters and remain continuous enough for the vehicle to traverse ordinary slopes without artificial steps at tile or segment boundaries
OSM bridge, tunnel, layer, ramp, and related topology semantics are combined with elevation so grade-separated crossings do not become false flat intersections
compiler fixtures cover at least one bridge/viaduct, one tunnel or below-grade segment, and one multi-level highway/ramp case representative of NYC complexity
diagnostics identify unresolved or contradictory vertical topology instead of silently flattening it
verify: python3 -m pytest tools/map_compiler/tests -k 'elevation or bridge or tunnel or grade'
